secrets.name: BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Without it the app still boots and serves /, /health and /telegram-webhook, but it cannot answer Telegram messages. Never commit it.

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret Telegram sends back in the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header (32+ random characters). A development value was generated by Base44 so the webhook is not wide open; replace it with your own random string for production.

secrets.name: SERPAPI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional SerpAPI key used for the online price search fallback. Leave unset to skip online price enrichment entirely.
